title: Help desk transformation solution design document
scenario: Discovery for LFG's Enterprise Help Desk Transformation is done: 182 agents in three sites on Avaya voice, Genesys chat and Five9 notifications, with ServiceNow and Okta, signed-off requirements and a four-month path to a pilot. Write the solution design document the steering committee and the offshore build team will review.
task: Target architecture with a diagram, using current Connect capabilities
Journeys, identity tiers, routing and a staffing estimate from the given peak
ServiceNow and Okta integration patterns, AI with evaluation, analytics and QA
Delivery plan with migration, cutover, rollback and an offshore RACI; risks, ADRs, cost
acceptance: Review-only: grade.sh reports 0/0, the rubric carries 100 points
Every requirement traced to a design element and a measure
Numbers for staffing and cost; no unsupported patterns
